body:
## Problem

Open the messages pager (`g<`), then search for something not there. On hitting `<CR>`:

```
E384: Search hit TOP without match for: win
vim.schedule callback: .../nvim/runtime/lua/vim/_core/ui2/messages.lua:243: Invalid 'end_col': out of range
stack traceback:
	[C]: in function 'nvim_buf_set_extmark'
	.../nvim/runtime/lua/vim/_core/ui2/messages.lua:243: in function 'expand_msg'
	.../nvim/runtime/lua/vim/_core/ui2/messages.lua:335: in function 'set_target_pos'
	.../nvim/runtime/lua/vim/_core/ui2/messages.lua:396: in function 'show_msg'
	.../nvim/runtime/lua/vim/_core/ui2/messages.lua:496: in function 'handler'
	vim/_core/ui2:164: in function 'fn'
	[string "vim/_core/editor"]:408: in function <[string "vim/_core/editor"]:407>
Error in "msg_show" UI event handler (ns=nvim.ui2):
Lua: .../nvim/runtime/lua/vim/_core/ui2/messages.lua:243: Invalid 'end_col': out of range
stack traceback:
	[C]: in function 'nvim_buf_set_extmark'
	.../nvim/runtime/lua/vim/_core/ui2/messages.lua:243: in function 'expand_msg'
	.../nvim/runtime/lua/vim/_core/ui2/messages.lua:335: in function 'set_target_pos'
	.../nvim/runtime/lua/vim/_core/ui2/messages.lua:396: in function 'show_msg'
	.../nvim/runtime/lua/vim/_core/ui2/messages.lua:496: in function 'handler'
	vim/_core/ui2:164: in function 'ui_callback'
	vim/_core/ui2:213: in function <vim/_core/ui2:205>
```

## Solution

Only copy extmarks for our (ui2) namespace

the change looks obvious enough, we could just skip the test if it's too much trouble. or adjust an existing test.

comment_data.body:
I think I've managed to get a test that fails before the fix - oddly, the test seems to only pass when I have a `snapshot_util()` call:

https://github.com/neovim/neovim/blob/1824246d9d5cc1f696f02d2d70e2320aa0a5aa41/test/functional/ui/messages2_spec.lua#L1387-L1397

So I expect there's something I'm not following. The test had been failing with an odd highlight check

<details><summary>Test screen output</summary>

```
Actual:
  |                                                     |
  |{1:~                                                    }|
  |{1:~                                                    }|
  |{1:~                                                    }|
  |{1:~                                                    }|
  |{1:~                                                    }|
  |{1:~                                                    }|
  |{1:~                                                    }|
  |{1:~                                                    }|
  |{1:~                                                    }|
  |{3:                                                     }|
  |^hello                                                |
  |{19:search hit BOTTOM, continuing at TOP}                 |
  |*{9:E486: Pattern not found: }{UNEXPECTED foreground = Screen.colors.Gray100, background = Screen.colors.Yellow1:pattern-not-present}         
|
```

</details>

Specifically the final line:
```
  |*{9:E486: Pattern not found: }{UNEXPECTED foreground = Screen.colors.Gray100, background = Screen.colors.Yellow1:pattern-not-present}      
                                 ^~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~   
```

which I don't understand - I added extra `attr_ids` suggested by `snapshot_util()` to no avail

@@ -1358,6 +1356,44 @@ describe('messages2', function()
     screen:expect_unchanged()
   end)
 
+  it('no end_col error when searching in pager', function()
+    screen:add_extra_attr_ids({
+      [100] = { foreground = Screen.colors.Magenta, bold = true },
+    })
+
+    command('set cmdheight=0 | echo "hello"') -- create ui.bufs.cmd
+
+    -- Place a "foreign" (non-ui-namespace) highlight extmark directly in ui.bufs.cmd.
+    exec_lua(function()
+      vim.api.nvim_set_hl(0, 'ForeignTest', { bold = true, fg = 'Red' })
+      local ns = vim.api.nvim_create_namespace('foreign-test')
+      local ui = require('vim._core.ui2')
+      vim.api.nvim_buf_set_extmark(ui.bufs.cmd, ns, 0, 0, { hl_group = 'ForeignTest', end_col = 1 })
+    end)
+
+    feed('g<lt>')
+
+    -- Ensure "foreign" extmarks are not copied into the pager.
+    screen:expect([[
+                                                           |
+      {1:~                                                    }|*11
+      {3:                                                     }|
+      ^hello                                                |
+    ]])
+
+    -- And we don't get an out of bounds end_col when search for non-existant text
+    feed('/pattern-not-present<CR>')
+    screen:snapshot_util()
+    screen:expect([[
+                                                           |
+      {1:~                                                    }|*9
+      {3:                                                     }|
+      ^hello                                                |
+      {19:search hit BOTTOM, continuing at TOP}                 |
+      {9:E486: Pattern not found: }{32:pattern-not-present}         |

comment_data.body:
Seem to have got it - `screen:snapshot_util()` mutates state, specifically the attrs:

https://github.com/neovim/neovim/blob/e28d725e469d991fc80d324cdd39a2b4b6d7e5f7/test/functional/ui/screen.lua#L1855-L1860

and combined with a `sleep` to let the screen settle appears to be why it allows the test to pass.

https://github.com/neovim/neovim/blob/e28d725e469d991fc80d324cdd39a2b4b6d7e5f7/test/functional/ui/screen.lua#L1676

Not fixed by that PR, but I've sorted the test now - fails when the extmark namespace isn't specified, passes when we specify `ui.ns`

I feel the test's a bit hacky with poking at internals, if it's not great, like you say, maybe we drop the test and merge just the code change?
